answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Trust flows along the graph and thins with distance: a newcomer endorsed only by fresh keys carries no weight. A farm must recruit 8 real sponsors per alias or sit unendorsed, and tight clusters that vouch only for each other are detected and paid as one. Trust decays with each hop, so distance from the core is the price. The horizon test is the live device, the reef test is the locked stake, and the meadow test is the graded history no template can fake. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
